instruction: Pour the liquid from the first red bottle into the first white bowl, from the second turquoise bottle into the second black bowl, and from the third violet bottle into the third brown bowl. Then reset the robot arm.

arguments.note: The red bottle is on the right, behind the white bowl. Approach its body horizontally so its neck remains clear for pouring.
